stemMd: Every temporary permit expires within six months. Some permits issued to vendors are temporary. Every expired permit must be renewed before its holder may operate under it again. Which follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: No vendor can operate for more than six months.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every temporary permit is issued to a vendor.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every vendor permit expires within six months.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Some permits issued to vendors will require renewal before they can authorize operation after they expire.

explanationMd: Use the temporary vendor permits that the premises say exist. They will expire within six months and then fall under the universal renewal requirement. The conclusion remains limited to some permits, not all vendors.

distractorRationale.d: Only some vendor permits are said to be temporary.
distractorRationale.b: The overlap cannot be reversed into a universal claim.
distractorRationale.a: Renewal or another valid permit may authorize later operation.
distractorRationale.c: Permanent permits may also expire under other rules.
